title: Marker Strict
statement: Implement `solve(mark, known)`. `known` is the list of registered pytest marks. Return `ok` when `mark` is in the list. Return `unknown` when it is not. A typo should not silently do nothing.
constraints: Empty known list rejects every mark

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: pytest can warn or fail on an unregistered mark.

editorial: pytest can warn or fail on an unregistered mark. Strict markers turn a typo in a skip or an integration mark into a failed collection instead of a test that always runs. The known list is the registry in pyproject.
reference_solution:
def solve(mark, known):
    return "ok" if mark in known else "unknown"
